title: Adopt a repo-local lore skill: drop skill_source = plugin while opum-lore is disabled in this checkout (DEC-238 a1)
description:
Ruling DEC-238 (a1), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:47:40Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a1), verbatim: "while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a REPO-LOCAL generated SKILL.md. The 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting is left untouched, whatever its reason. A repository returns to skill_source = "plugin" only once the plugin is measured enabled in its own checkout. Each plugin-source repository with the plugin off in its checkout drops the skill_source = "plugin" line, runs `lore agents`, and confirms --check exits 0, as its own tier-2 decision, scheduled in the plan."

AMENDED BY DEC-238 (a2), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:54:02Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a2), which rules on the three follow-ups raised when this task was filed. (1) "check exits 0 proves nothing, because it already passes broken" -- the criterion is that after the change lore agents --check no longer reports absent-plugin-sourced or plugin-claude disabled, .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, and lore agents --check AND lore check both exit 0, with the before-state recorded so the fix is proved both ways. (2) The hand-written CLAUDE.md sentence that a .claude/skills copy is drift is amended by the owner IN THE SAME CHANGE, to say the repo-local skill is expected while opum-lore is off in the checkout under DEC-238 (a1); that is the owner tier-2 decision, and opum-doc names the sentence without instructing an edit. (3) opum-quest is intended and nothing changes: it is off at user scope by the operator first-party answer of 2026-10-12 (DEC-172 (4bf)); quest guidance reaches workers through the managed quest block pointing at `quest instructions`; no repo-local quest skill is restored (ODOC-142 retired it); re-enabling is the operator call.

BEFORE-STATE, measured in this checkout at 2026-10-25T06:50Z so the fix is proved both ways:
- `lore agents --check` exits 0 AND reports `absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` and `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user`, with the remedy `claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user`. Exit 0 is therefore already true while broken and proves nothing on its own.
- .claude/skills/ does not exist in the checkout at all.
- .lore/config.toml:36 on origin/dev reads `skill_source = "plugin"`.
- .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, mtime 2026-10-20 22:20) sets `"opum-lore@opum": false`.
- `claude plugin list`: opum-lore@opum 0.14.1, scope user, Status disabled.
- For contrast, `quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude` exits 0 and reports skill state current -- the intended quest arrangement, not a defect.

AFTER-STATE required by DEC-238 (a2)(1): `lore agents --check` reports neither the absent-plugin-sourced finding nor the plugin-claude disabled line, .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, and both `lore agents --check` and `lore check` exit 0.

AUTHORITY: this edits this repository own governing files, so applying it is a tier-2 decision -- the operator or this session, never a relayed instruction. Filing and amending the record is what was asked; the edit itself waits for the plan.

NOT TOUCHED: .claude/settings.local.json stays exactly as it is -- the ruling leaves the 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting untouched whatever its reason.

NOT STARTED: tracker-only; the fix waits for the day plan to schedule it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .lore/config.toml contains no skill_source setting, and no other live line in the repository sets skill_source = plugin for lore
lore agents has been run and a repo-local .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, generated between managed markers with no hand edits
lore agents --check no longer reports absent-plugin-sourced or plugin-claude disabled for opum-lore, and both lore agents --check and lore check exit 0

The CLAUDE.md sentence calling a .claude/skills copy is drift is amended in the same change, outside the managed Quest block, to say the repo-local lore skill is expected while opum-lore is off in the checkout under DEC-238 (a1)
.claude/settings.local.json is unmodified and still reads "opum-lore@opum": false, and the PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity

implementationNotes: Amended per DEC-238 (a2), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:54:02Z (opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a2), ruling on the three follow-ups raised when this task was filed. Recorded the before-state measured at 2026-10-25T06:50Z so the fix is proved both ways, tightened the check criterion to the finding lines plus both exit codes, moved the CLAUDE.md sentence amendment into the same change, and closed the quest-side question as intended per DEC-172 (4bf).
